learning_outcomes.text: Describe the first-aider's role, scene safety and priorities
Explain primary assessment and the recovery position
Describe the principles of CPR and choking response
Explain management of bleeding, shock and wounds
Describe response to burns, fractures and environmental injury
Explain recognition of common medical emergencies

integrative_case: A factory safety officer reviews a near-miss where a worker collapsed. Using first-aid theory, they reconstruct the correct sequence from scene safety through primary assessment and summoning help, identify what was done out of order, and note where accredited hands-on skills would be required in practice.
